description:
(Summary from jobright.ai; the original posting may say more.)

Microsoft develops device and app management solutions through its Intune platform. The Software Engineer will design, develop, maintain, and safely release scalable software and client components across multiple platforms, collaborate with engineering teams, use modern AI tools, and resolve customer issues.
Software Engineer building cross-platform endpoint management services and safely shipping customer-facing software at scale

Responsibilities:
• Designs, develops, and maintains software across a variety of platforms and technology stacks, including highly scaled .NET services and client components on iOS, macOS, Linux, Windows, and the web
• Collaborates with engineers across teams to deliver software solutions that millions of people rely on to get their work done
• Contributes to the development of customer-focused products and services while working in a collaborative engineering environment
• Leverages modern AI tools to design and implement software for various tech stacks
• Collaborates with other engineers to solve urgent customer problems
• Release what you build safely to millions of users

Requirements:
• • Bachelor's Degree in Computer Science, or related technical discipline with proven experience coding in languages including, but not limited to, C, C++, C#, Java, JavaScript, or Python
+ OR equivalent experience
• • Ability to meet Microsoft, customer and/or government security screening requirements are required for this role. These requirements include, but are not limited to the following specialized security screenings: Microsoft Cloud Background Check: This position will be required to pass the Microsoft background and Microsoft Cloud background check upon hire/transfer and every two years thereafter

Preferred:
• • Bachelor's Degree in Computer Science, or related technical field AND 1+ year(s) technical engineering experience with coding in languages including, but not limited to, C, C++, C#, Java, JavaScript, Rust, or Python.
+ OR Master's Degree in Computer Science or related technical field with proven experience coding in languages including, but not limited to, C, C++, C#, Java, JavaScript, Rust, or Python.
+ OR equivalent experience
